children: Cboe Europe intends to admit Midsummer AB shares to trading, expected on 13 Oct 2026, supplementing its listing on Nasdaq First North Growth Market. No new shares will be issued and no action is required from existing shareholders.
A second venue can tighten spreads and improve liquidity, aiding price discovery.
Maintains primary trading while adding broader access.
Potential to attract international flow and institutions.

This is an early-stage liquidity and access move, not a capital raise. A meaningful catalyst would be measurable volume/spread improvement post-admission or inclusion in additional trading programs driving sustained demand.
